Ampère Excellence Scholarships for International Students at ENS de Lyon 2026

The Ampère Scholarships of Excellence provide outstanding international students the opportunity to pursue eligible Master's programs at ENS de Lyon. This financial award offers partial funding of up to €1,000 per month to support selected candidates.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Candidates seeking admission to a master's programme must present documentation proving they have earned a licence (equivalent to 180 ECTS European credits) or an equivalent diploma.
  • Applicants for Masters Year 2 must demonstrate successful completion of Masters Year 1 (240 ECTS European credits) or hold an equivalent degree.

Required Application Documents

  • Two referee letters (in French or English) from professors familiar with the applicant's work.
  • Motivation letter.
  • Curriculum Vitae.
  • Certificates of diplomas and degrees already obtained.
  • University academic transcript of records.
  • Proof of enrollment for the current year (documents accepted only in French or English).
